title: Bigger number, fainter unit
description: Enlarges the leading digits of the countdown and shrinks/fades the unit label so the number itself dominates the scan. The now-row swaps 'ahora' for the boundary phrase '< 1 min', which is deliberately ambiguous between two readings: (a) a literal countdown floor — 'less than one minute remains' — for a system that always shows a number; or (b) 'ahora' itself re-expressed on the same numeric scale as the rows below it, so the whole column reads as one continuous unit rather than a label breaking the pattern. Either reading is a legitimate rationale for the same rendered text; which one applies depends on whether the underlying etaMinutes===0 state is treated as a true zero or as 'less than 1'.

changes.intent: Make the number the dominant visual element of the row.
Push the unit further into the background relative to baseline's 0.45em/ink-muted so the number reads first.
Replace the 'ahora' label with a boundary phrase that reads as part of the same numeric scale as the rows below it.
changes.detail: When etaMinutes===0 (the now/ABORDANDO state), render .arrival-row__eta as '< 1' + .arrival-row__eta-unit('min') instead of the literal text 'ahora'. .arrival-row--now .arrival-row__eta keeps its accent-text color from baseline; SALIENDO/departing rows are unchanged.
